title: Add shape filter with bulk inline editing to product management

requirements.text: Add shape filter buttons above the ProductManagementTable component (frontend/src/components/ProductManagementTable.tsx) that display all unique shape values from the product list as clickable button tabs, similar to the marketplace filter UI implementation. Include an 'All' button to show all products without shape filtering.

quotes: 1 the shape filter be added as buttons above the product management table (similar to the marketplace filters

acceptanceCriteria: Shape filter buttons appear above the product management table
Buttons display all unique shape values from products plus 'All' option
Button styling matches the marketplace filter button design
Active filter button has distinct visual styling
Clicking a shape button filters the table to show only products with that shape
Clicking 'All' shows all products regardless of shape

requirements.text: Create React state management in ProductManagementTable component to track the selected shape filter and implement filtering logic that filters the displayed product rows based on the active shape selection, working in conjunction with the existing checkbox selection system.

quotes: 3 the shape filter work with those same checkboxes

acceptanceCriteria: State tracks currently selected shape filter (or 'All')
Product table rows are filtered based on selected shape
Filter works independently of checkbox selection state
Existing checkbox selection remains functional after filtering
Selected products remain selected when changing shape filter
Filter state persists during inline editing operations

requirements.text: Add bulk inline editing functionality to ProductManagementTable component where modifying any field (title, description, shape, category, price, inventory count) on one product while that product and other products are selected via checkboxes will apply those same changes to all selected products simultaneously. Display a visual indicator showing which products are selected for bulk editing.

quotes: 2 Inline editing where you modify one product and apply those changes to all selected products

acceptanceCriteria: When multiple products are selected via checkboxes and one product enters edit mode, changes apply to all selected products
All editable fields support bulk editing: title, description, shape, category, price, inventory count
Visual indicator shows which products will receive bulk changes
Confirmation dialog appears before applying bulk changes
Success notification displays count of products updated
Error handling shows which products failed to update if any
Bulk edit works with filtered product views (shape filter active)
After bulk update, all affected products show updated values immediately

requirements.text: Create a React Query mutation hook useBulkUpdateProducts in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts that accepts an array of product IDs and a set of field updates, calls the backend updateProduct method for each selected product with the same field values, handles errors for individual updates, and invalidates the product list cache after successful completion.

quotes: 2 Inline editing where you modify one product and apply those changes to all selected products

acceptanceCriteria: Hook accepts array of product IDs and update object with modified fields
Calls backend updateProduct for each product ID with same field values
Returns success/failure status for each product update
Invalidates product queries after successful bulk update
Provides error details for any failed updates
Supports optimistic updates for immediate UI feedback

constraints: Shape filter UI must match the existing marketplace filter button design and layout
Bulk editing must work with the existing checkbox selection system without breaking bulk delete functionality
All inline editing validation rules must apply to bulk updates (e.g., price validation, inventory count validation)
Filtered views must maintain checkbox selection state when switching between shape filters
nonGoals: Creating new bulk edit interfaces separate from inline editing
Adding shape filter to other pages besides product management
Modifying the backend updateProduct method structure
Adding bulk operations beyond editing (e.g., bulk publish, bulk archive)
